name: Denis Deery
bio:
Denis grew up in Dundee and earned an HNC in Applied Science from Dundee and Angus College in 2019. He then completed a BSc in Chemistry with Medicinal Chemistry in 2024 and an MSc (Res) in Chemistry in 2026 at the University of St Andrews. Working under Prof. David O’Hagan, his research focused on the synthesis and manipulation of all-cis fluorocyclohexane building blocks.
Denis joined the Greenfield Group as a PhD student in 2026, where he is developing photoswitchable imines as light-responsive cofactors for self-assembled catalytic capsules.
